# `files` operations

5 operations. Generated from `assets/operations.json`; [all references](index.md).

### files.list

Show project files. read-only, idempotent.

List a project directory, folders first. Paths remain confined to the selected project root.

- `path` string, required (non-empty)
- `directory` string (default "")
- `hidden` boolean (default false)
- `generated` boolean (default false)

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.list '{"path":"<path>"}'
```

### files.read

Open source file. read-only, idempotent.

Read up to 1 MiB of UTF-8 source and its SHA-256 revision.

- `path` string, required (non-empty)
- `file` string, required (non-empty)

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.read '{"path":"<path>","file":"<file>"}'
```

### files.write

Save source file. **destructive, ask first**, idempotent.

Atomically save text when if_match equals the current SHA-256; use an empty revision only for new files.

- `path` string, required (non-empty)
- `file` string, required (non-empty)
- `text` string, required (up to 1048576 characters)
- `if_match` string, required (matching `([a-f0-9]{64})?`)

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.write '{"path":"<path>","file":"<file>","text":"<text>","if_match":"<if_match>"}'
```

### files.mkdir

Create project folder. writes, idempotent.

Create one new folder inside a project.

- `path` string, required (non-empty)
- `directory` string, required (non-empty)

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.mkdir '{"path":"<path>","directory":"<directory>"}'
```

### files.search

Search project. read-only, idempotent.

Bounded source search, skipping generated trees and symlinks; returns file, line, column and matching text.

- `path` string, required (non-empty)
- `query` string, required (non-empty, up to 1000 characters)
- `regex` boolean (default false)
- `case_sensitive` boolean (default false)
- `hidden` boolean (default false)
- `limit` integer (1 to 1000; default 200)

```sh
tomaccoctl call files.search '{"path":"<path>","query":"<query>"}'
```
